strings.zh: 欢迎来到狩猎场！{SCROLL}您要花{VAR:0134:1}元{NEWLINE}在狩猎场内{CLEAR}尽情享受捕捉的乐趣吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Welcome to the Safari Zone!{SCROLL}For just ${VAR:0134:1}, you can play the{NEWLINE}Safari Game.{SCROLL}You can roam the wide-open Safari Zone{NEWLINE}and catch whatever you like.{CLEAR}Would you like to play? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 主人好！{NEWLINE}欢迎来到狩猎场！{SCROLL}您要花{VAR:0134:1}元{NEWLINE}在狩猎场内{CLEAR}尽情享受捕捉的乐趣吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Owner!{NEWLINE}Welcome to the Safari Zone!{SCROLL}For just ${VAR:0134:1}, you can play the{NEWLINE}Safari Game.{SCROLL}You can roam the wide-open Safari Zone{NEWLINE}and catch what you like.{CLEAR}Would you like to play? {VAR:0200:0}{NEWLINE}

strings.zh: 收您{VAR:0134:1}元。{SCROLL}
strings.en: That’ll be ${VAR:0134:1}, please!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 那欢迎下次再来。
strings.en: OK.{NEWLINE}Please come again!

strings.zh: 请收好狩猎球。{SCROLL}
strings.en: Here are your Safari Balls!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}得到了{NEWLINE}{VAR:0133:1}个狩猎球。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0} received {VAR:0133:1} Safari Balls.
strings.notes: US 0135/5 | RV051: addition: US 'from the attendant' not in zh

strings.zh: 当您的狩猎球用完后{NEWLINE}我们会对您发出通知,{CLEAR}请尽情享受{SCROLL}狩猎的乐趣！{SCROLL}
strings.en: We’ll call for you when you run out of{NEWLINE}Safari Balls.{CLEAR}Well, I hope you enjoy it!{SCROLL}Go, and have fun!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 您的球还有剩余,{NEWLINE}要结束狩猎游戏吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: You still have Safari Balls left.{NEWLINE}Leave the Safari Zone? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 好的,{SCROLL}您剩下的狩猎球{NEWLINE}将由我们保存。{SCROLL}
strings.en: Certainly.{SCROLL}Please return any Safari Balls you may{NEWLINE}have remaining.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 欢迎下次再来。
strings.en: Did you have fun?{NEWLINE}Please come again!

strings.zh: 您的钱不够,{SCROLL}欢迎下次再来。
strings.en: I am sorry.{NEWLINE}You don’t have enough money.{SCROLL}I hope you will drop by again.

strings.zh: 主人！{NEWLINE}您的钱不够,{SCROLL}欢迎下次再来。
strings.en: Owner!{NEWLINE}You don’t have enough money.{SCROLL}I hope you drop by again.

strings.zh: 您盒子里的空间不够了,{SCROLL}请整理后再来。
strings.en: I am sorry.{NEWLINE}There is no room left in the PC!{SCROLL}Please come back after you have made{NEWLINE}some room.

strings.zh: 主人！{NEWLINE}您盒子里的空间不够了,{SCROLL}请整理后再来。
strings.en: Owner!{NEWLINE}There is no room left in the PC!{SCROLL}Please come back after you have made{NEWLINE}some room.

strings.zh: 欢迎来到狩猎场！{SCROLL}您是第一次来狩猎场吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Hi! Is it your first time here at{NEWLINE}the Safari Zone? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 主人,您好！{SCROLL}要听一下{NEWLINE}狩猎的说明吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Welcome, Owner!{NEWLINE}Should I explain the Safari Zone? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 在狩猎场,你可以使用{NEWLINE}{VAR:0133:1}个狩猎球{CLEAR}捕捉精灵,{CLEAR}尽情享受狩猎的乐趣。{SCROLL}球一旦用完,{NEWLINE}即代表狩猎的结束。{SCROLL}在狩猎过程中,{NEWLINE}当你遇到了精灵,{CLEAR}可以选择诱饵或者泥巴{CLEAR}向它扔去。{SCROLL}诱饵扔中后,{NEWLINE}精灵会难以逃脱,{CLEAR}但也会下降捕获的成功几率。{SCROLL}泥巴扔中后,{NEWLINE}精灵会更容易捕捉到,{CLEAR}但也会提高逃跑的几率。{SCROLL}欢迎进入狩猎的世界！
strings.en: At the Safari Zone, you can enjoy a{NEWLINE}Safari Game where you are given {VAR:0133:1}{CLEAR}Safari Balls to try to catch Pokémon.{SCROLL}When you have run out of Safari Balls,{NEWLINE}the game is over.{SCROLL}When you see a Pokémon, you can choose{NEWLINE}to throw Bait or Mud.{SCROLL}If you throw Bait, Pokémon tend to stay{NEWLINE}but will become more difficult to catch.{SCROLL}If you throw Mud, it will become easier{NEWLINE}to catch, but the Pokémon may flee.{SCROLL}Have fun at the Safari Zone!

strings.zh: 欢迎进入狩猎的世界！
strings.en: Have fun at the Safari Zone!

strings.zh: 巴奥巴园长有事找你。
strings.en: Warden Baoba has something important{NEWLINE}to share with you!

strings.zh: 这里是区域自定义,{NEWLINE}要听取什么说明吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: This is the Area Customizer.{NEWLINE}What would you like to know about? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 狩猎场由６个区域构成,{SCROLL}诸如草原区域、岩石区域{CLEAR}等多种特色鲜明的地方。{SCROLL}区域自定义则可以将这些区域{CLEAR}自由交替更换。{SCROLL}要听取什么说明吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: The Safari Zone has six Areas.{SCROLL}Plains Area...{NEWLINE}Peak Area...{CLEAR}and so on.{SCROLL}The Area Customizer allows you to{NEWLINE}change the combination of these Areas.{SCROLL}What would you like to know? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 调查设备就能进入{CLEAR}区域自定义的画面。{SCROLL}下屏会显示狩猎场目前的{CLEAR}构成状态。{SCROLL}按下Ａ键选中要更换的区域{CLEAR}就能与其他不同的区域进行更换。{SCROLL}要听取什么说明吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Check out the machine, and you’ll see{NEWLINE}the Area Customizer screen.{SCROLL}The lower window shows the current{NEWLINE}Safari Zone setting.{SCROLL}Select an Area with the A Button to{NEWLINE}swap it with another.{SCROLL}What would you like to know? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 选取区域后{NEWLINE}选择「更换」,{CLEAR}此时画面上会显示{CLEAR}１２个全新的区域。{SCROLL}从中选择自己想要的区域{CLEAR}然后按下Ａ键确定即可。{SCROLL}要听取什么说明吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: When you select an Area, then select{NEWLINE}Swap, you will see 12 new Areas.{SCROLL}Select one of them by highlighting it and{NEWLINE}pressing the A Button.{SCROLL}What would you like to know? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 选取区域后{NEWLINE}选择「更换排列」{SCROLL}就能在不更改区域种类的前提下{NEWLINE}对地点的排列进行变更{SCROLL}要听取什么说明吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: When you select an Area, then select{NEWLINE}Order, the Area type will not change,{CLEAR}but the location can now be changed.{SCROLL}What would you like to know? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 狩猎场中,{NEWLINE}各个区域内栖息的精灵各不相同。{SCROLL}所以当你改变区域后,{NEWLINE}出现的精灵也会改变。{SCROLL}要抓到更多的精灵,{NEWLINE}就请务必多更换区域！{SCROLL}要听取什么说明吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Different Areas have different Pokémon{NEWLINE}living in them, so when you change{CLEAR}Areas, you will see different Pokémon.{SCROLL}Please do try the different Areas!{NEWLINE}What would you like to know? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 非常抱歉,{NEWLINE}我们目前还在准备阶段。{SCROLL}巴奥巴园长貌似对这设备{CLEAR}有一个伟大的想法。{CLEAR}详细内容,{CLEAR}我们也不清楚。
strings.en: I am sorry, but this can’t be used yet.{SCROLL}Warden Baoba has a great plan for this{NEWLINE}machine...or so he says. But even we{CLEAR}don’t know the details.
strings.notes: US 0135/25 | RV051: addition: US 'It’s a secret.' not in zh

strings.zh: 尽请享受{NEWLINE}区域自定义！
strings.en: Please enjoy the Area Customizer!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}按下了{NEWLINE}区域自定义的开关！{SCROLL}
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0} turned on{NEWLINE}the Area Customizer!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 正在调整中。
strings.en: It is still under development.

strings.zh: 我们狩猎场刚刚完成了设备更新,{NEWLINE}目前正准备试运营。{CLEAR}为了对你送药的辛苦表示感谢,{CLEAR}我想请你率先来体验一下{CLEAR}我突发奇想出来的狩猎主人测试。{CLEAR}怎么样,有兴趣吗？
strings.en: Our Safari Zone has just finished{NEWLINE}upgrading its facilities, and we’re{CLEAR}getting ready for a trial run.{SCROLL}To thank you for all your trouble{NEWLINE}delivering the medicine, I’d like you to{CLEAR}be the first to try the Safari Zone{CLEAR}Owner test I came up with on a whim. How{CLEAR}about it? Interested?

strings.zh: 很好！{SCROLL}接下来我给你讲一些{NEWLINE}关于测试的说明,{SCROLL}别怕,这事没你想的那么难。{SCROLL}在狩猎场中抓一只小拳石,{CLEAR}让我看过之后就算合格。{SCROLL}进入狩猎场后,{NEWLINE}你能在附近的草丛里{CLEAR}找到小拳石。{SCROLL}走吧,{NEWLINE}祝你好运。
strings.en: Right on! Let me explain how the test{NEWLINE}works. Don’t worry, it’s not as hard as{CLEAR}you think.{SCROLL}All you have to do is catch one Geodude{NEWLINE}in the Safari Zone and show it to me,{CLEAR}and you pass.{SCROLL}Once you’re inside, you’ll find Geodude{NEWLINE}in the grass near the entrance.{SCROLL}Off you go. Good luck!
strings.notes: US 0135/30; modernised from US 0135#30 | RV051: meaning: zh 'not as hard as you think' and pass condition; dropped US 'It shouldn’t take long'

strings.zh: 想不到你居然会拒绝我的请求。{SCROLL}这可是成为狩猎场主人的好机会啊！{SCROLL}主人……{NEWLINE}这称号是不是很酷？{SCROLL}还是试试吧！{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Wow, I never thought anyone{NEWLINE}would decline!{SCROLL}You can become the Safari Zone Owner,{NEWLINE}don’t you see?{SCROLL}Owner...{NEWLINE}It’s got a nice ring to it, doesn’t it?{SCROLL}You should try the test! {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 哦,你把小拳石给抓住了,{NEWLINE}干得漂亮！{SCROLL}第一项测试{NEWLINE}合格！{SCROLL}……　……　……{NEWLINE}我没跟你说过吗？{SCROLL}这次的测试一共有两个。{SCROLL}哪有这么容易就能成为主人。{SCROLL}第二项测试是……{SCROLL}抱歉,我还没有准备好,{NEWLINE}准备完毕之后,{CLEAR}我会用手机联络你的,{CLEAR}你就等着吧！
strings.en: Oh, wonderful!{NEWLINE}You’ve caught a Geodude!{CLEAR}You’ve passed the first test.{SCROLL}..................{SCROLL}Huh? Didn’t I tell you that there are{NEWLINE}two tests?{SCROLL}That’s right!{NEWLINE}Becoming an owner is not that easy.{SCROLL}The second test is...{NEWLINE}Well, I am still preparing for it.{SCROLL}I will let you know once it’s ready.{NEWLINE}You need to wait just a little.{CLEAR}I will call you with the Pokégear.

strings.zh: 加油,{NEWLINE}快把小拳石抓来给我！{SCROLL}进入狩猎场后,{NEWLINE}你能在附近的草丛里{CLEAR}找到小拳石。{SCROLL}走吧,{NEWLINE}祝你好运。
strings.en: Come on, hurry and catch me a Geodude!{SCROLL}Once you’re inside the Safari Zone,{NEWLINE}you’ll find Geodude in the grass near{CLEAR}the entrance.{SCROLL}Off you go. Good luck!
strings.notes: US 0135/33; modernised from US 0135#33 | RV051: meaning: zh urges player on; dropped US 'It shouldn’t take long'

strings.zh: 等很久了吧,{NEWLINE}我们的准备已经完毕了。{SCROLL}下一项测试是让你抓一只{CLEAR}穿山鼠给我看。{SCROLL}你是不是觉得这个和{NEWLINE}第一项测试没什么区别？{SCROLL}错！{SCROLL}就目前的情况,{NEWLINE}穿山鼠是不会出现的！{SCROLL}接下来,{NEWLINE}就该让这家伙上场了！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Sorry to keep you waiting!{NEWLINE}Everything’s ready.{SCROLL}For the next test, catch a Sandshrew{NEWLINE}and show it to me.{SCROLL}You think that’s no different from the{NEWLINE}first test? Wrong!{SCROLL}The way things are now, Sandshrew{NEWLINE}won’t appear!{SCROLL}And that’s where this baby comes in!{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0135/34; modernised from US 0135#34 | RV051: meaning: 等很久了吧 = sorry to keep you waiting, not 'I’ve been waiting for you'

strings.zh: 这东西可是能够{NEWLINE}自由改变狩猎场区域的{CLEAR}高科技设备！{SCROLL}我给起名叫区域自定义。{SCROLL}至于他是通过何种原理运作的……{CLEAR}我可不能告诉你！{SCROLL}放心,这东西简单得很,{NEWLINE}我相信你马上就能熟悉了。{SCROLL}详细内容你可以向{NEWLINE}旁边的工作人员讯问。{SCROLL}
strings.en: This sophisticated, high-tech machine{NEWLINE}lets you customize Safari Zone Areas.{CLEAR}I call it the Area Customizer!{SCROLL}You want to know how it works,{NEWLINE}don’t you?{CLEAR}It’s a...secret!{SCROLL}Well, you shouldn’t have trouble{NEWLINE}operating it. Just talk to the staff{CLEAR}next to me!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 跑题了跑题了！{SCROLL}第二项测试的说明还没讲完呢。{SCROLL}穿山鼠不会出现在{NEWLINE}目前的狩猎场区域中。{SCROLL}因此！{SCROLL}你需要使用区域自定义{NEWLINE}改变狩猎场的区域{CLEAR}才能找到它。{SCROLL}穿山鼠出没的地点为……{NEWLINE}沙漠！{SCROLL}走吧,{NEWLINE}我祝你好运！
strings.en: I almost forgot!{SCROLL}I was in the middle of explaining{NEWLINE}the second test, wasn’t I?{SCROLL}You will not see Sandshrew{NEWLINE}with the current Safari Zone Areas,{SCROLL}so you have to use the Area Customizer{NEWLINE}to change them.{SCROLL}Sandshrew live in the desert!{NEWLINE}Good luck!

strings.zh: 哦,你把穿山鼠给抓来了,{NEWLINE}干得漂亮！{SCROLL}你没有辜负我对你的期待！{SCROLL}很好,你合格了。{SCROLL}现在我授予你{NEWLINE}狩猎场主人的称号！{SCROLL}
strings.en: You did it!{SCROLL}You caught a Sandshrew!{NEWLINE}I knew you could do it.{SCROLL}You’ve passed the test!{NEWLINE}You are now the Safari Zone Owner!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 我一直都想看看{NEWLINE}那些深爱着精灵的年轻人{CLEAR}在狩猎场玩耍的身影。{SCROLL}说不定能从中得到灵感,{NEWLINE}制造出新的东西。{SCROLL}一来可以帮助你{NEWLINE}完成自己精灵图鉴的收集,{CLEAR}二来,我也能从中{SCROLL}学到一些东西。{SCROLL}
strings.en: I’ve always wanted to watch young{NEWLINE}people who deeply love Pokémon playing{CLEAR}in the Safari Zone.{SCROLL}Maybe I’ll find inspiration to make{CLEAR}something new.{SCROLL}That could help you complete your{CLEAR}Pokédex, and I could learn something{CLEAR}from it, too.{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0135/38 [D-2074 meaning-review-followup: source/context correction; agent-reviewed, not new human approval. ]

strings.zh: 话说……{SCROLL}你现在虽身为主人,{NEWLINE}不过……{CLEAR}你能支付{CLEAR}狩猎场的入场费吗？{SCROLL}我们也是要靠这个过日子的,{SCROLL}而且,我们还需要{NEWLINE}去研究一些新的设备{CLEAR}以方便你{CLEAR}完成自己的图鉴收集。{SCROLL}请慢慢享受狩猎场吧！
strings.en: By the way, though you are now the{NEWLINE}Safari Zone Owner, would you kindly{CLEAR}continue to pay admission?{SCROLL}We depend on it for our livelihood. We{NEWLINE}also need to research new equipment to{CLEAR}help you complete your Pokédex.{SCROLL}Take your time and enjoy the{NEWLINE}Safari Zone!
strings.notes: US 0135/39 [D-2061 meaning-review-30: independently LLM-reviewed source-faithful correction; not human-approved.]

strings.zh: 如果我想到了什么新的点子,{NEWLINE}会立刻打手机{CLEAR}跟你取得联络的。
strings.en: I will let you know as soon as I come up{NEWLINE}with something new, using the Pokégear!

strings.zh: 快把穿山鼠抓来给我看,{SCROLL}穿山鼠就在……{NEWLINE}沙漠！{SCROLL}走吧,{NEWLINE}祝你好运！
strings.en: Show me the Sandshrew once you’ve{NEWLINE}caught one. Sandshrew live in the{CLEAR}desert! Good luck!

strings.zh: 不用这么着急,{SCROLL}下个测试的准备{NEWLINE}完毕之后,我会立刻{CLEAR}用手机联系你的,{CLEAR}你就再耐心等等吧。
strings.en: Slow down.{SCROLL}Once the next test is ready, I will call{NEWLINE}you using the Pokégear.{SCROLL}Give me some time, OK?

strings.zh: 久等了！{SCROLL}新玩法的灵感我终于找到了！{SCROLL}那个玩法就叫……{NEWLINE}放置区块！{SCROLL}我说出来肯定吓你一跳！{NEWLINE}在狩猎场游戏的同时,{CLEAR}还能在区域内{CLEAR}自由放置区块！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Sorry to keep you waiting!{SCROLL}I finally found the inspiration{NEWLINE}for a new attraction!{SCROLL}I call it... Object Arrangement!{SCROLL}I bet that surprises you! As you play{NEWLINE}at the Safari Zone, you can place{CLEAR}objects freely in the Areas!{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0135/43 | RV051: meaning: 久等了 = sorry to keep you waiting; 吓你一跳 kept

strings.zh: 还有！{SCROLL}根据你放置的区块种类,{SCROLL}它还能改变该区域中{CLEAR}出现的精灵种类。{SCROLL}有新想法的话{NEWLINE}我会打手机给你的。{SCROLL}
strings.en: Not only that, but the types of Pokémon{NEWLINE}you see in an Area will change depending{CLEAR}on the types of objects you place.{SCROLL}I will call you using the Pokégear if I{NEWLINE}come up with something new!{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0135/44 | RV051: addition: US 'Isn’t it amazing?' not in zh

strings.zh: 我来为您对设置区块{NEWLINE}进行说明吧,{SCROLL}您想知道什么呢？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: I will explain Object Arrangement.{NEWLINE}Would you like to know anything? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 我来为您对设置区块{NEWLINE}进行说明吧,{SCROLL}你问什么我都能回答你。{SCROLL}
strings.en: I will explain Object Arrangement.{NEWLINE}Feel free to ask me any questions.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 其实就是在狩猎场内行动的同时,{NEWLINE}自由地在场内进行设置。{SCROLL}有一点请注意,{NEWLINE}台阶的上方以及{CLEAR}会有精灵出现的草丛内{CLEAR}是无法进行设置的。{SCROLL}另外,一个区域内{NEWLINE}最多只能放置{CLEAR}３０个区块。{SCROLL}所以放的时候{NEWLINE}要好好计划一下。{SCROLL}有什么想问的吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Basically, you can place objects freely{NEWLINE}as you walk around the Safari Zone.{SCROLL}You can’t place them on stairs, though,{NEWLINE}or in grass where Pokémon appear!{SCROLL}Also, you can place up to 30 objects in{NEWLINE}an Area, so plan carefully.{SCROLL}Would you like to know{NEWLINE}anything else? {VAR:0200:0}
strings.notes: US 0135/47 | RV051: omission: zh 'so plan carefully'; layout rebalance 2026-10-09 (prompt icons / single-word page)

strings.zh: 放置的方法非常简单,{NEWLINE}对前方进行调查,{SCROLL}如果是块空地就能选择{CLEAR}自己喜欢的区块。{SCROLL}区块被划分为多种大小,{CLEAR}有的时候会因为空间不够{CLEAR}而放不下去。{SCROLL}有什么想问的吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: It is easy to place objects. All you{NEWLINE}have to do is make sure that the spot{CLEAR}in front of you is clear.{SCROLL}If it’s empty, you can select{NEWLINE}an object.{SCROLL}Some objects are large and may need a{NEWLINE}large space.{SCROLL}Would you like to know anything{NEWLINE}else? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 调查你曾经{NEWLINE}放置过的区块{CLEAR}便可将其去除。{SCROLL}自己放置的区块{NEWLINE}会闪闪发光,{CLEAR}所以到了晚上{CLEAR}会很容易辨认出来。{SCROLL}有什么想问的吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: If you want to remove an object, just{NEWLINE}walk up to it and check it. The objects{CLEAR}you have placed will glow in the dark.{CLEAR}It should help you at night.{SCROLL}Would you like to know anything{NEWLINE}else? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 区块共分数个种类。{SCROLL}草类……{NEWLINE}树类……{CLEAR}岩类……{CLEAR}水类……{CLEAR}其他……{CLEAR}你可以多尝试几次,{SCROLL}在区域自定义设备上画面中,{NEWLINE}你可以查看到{CLEAR}自己在狩猎场中{CLEAR}放置过的区块种类。{SCROLL}种类也会慢慢增加。{SCROLL}有什么想问的吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: There are several kinds of objects.{NEWLINE}Grass... Trees... Rocks... Water...{CLEAR}And others...{SCROLL}Try placing different ones. On the Area{NEWLINE}Customizer screen, you can see the{CLEAR}kinds of objects you’ve placed in the{CLEAR}Safari Zone.{SCROLL}More kinds will be added over time.{SCROLL}Would you like to know{NEWLINE}anything else? {VAR:0200:0}
